general_background.title: Acid can change capping-ligand binding
general_background.summary: When used for acidity adjustment in an aqueous thiol-capped synthesis, acid changes the equilibrium between thiol and thiolate. Ligand protonation can change dissolved metal complexation and the colloidal stability of ligand-coated crystals.
